name: Shaker Heights
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Shaker Heights, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Shaker Heights, Ohio for 2026: the free Festival of Lights at Shaker Square on December 5, with dates checked on the city calendar.
lede: Shaker Heights adds a new tradition this year, a free Festival of Lights at Shaker Square honoring Christmas, Hanukkah and Kwanzaa.
celebrates: Shaker Heights' main family event this Christmas season is the inaugural Festival of Lights at Shaker Square on Saturday, December 5. The City of Shaker Heights calendar describes a family-friendly day of free activities honoring Christmas, Hanukkah and Kwanzaa, with interactive cultural experiences, photos with roaming characters and early morning breakfast and hot chocolate. Earlier in the season, City Ballet of Cleveland holds its Sugarplum Fairy Tea at the Shaker Heights Country Club to support the Uniquely Cleveland Nutcracker.
lastyear: We did not find a recap of Shaker Heights' 2025 holiday events. The City Ballet of Cleveland's Sugarplum Fairy Tea, listed on the city calendar for November 8, 2026, was its twelfth annual, so the tea has been a regular fall tradition for more than a decade, according to the city listing.
facts: The Festival of Lights is described as the inaugural one, so 2026 is the first year. Its theme is Many Traditions, One Community, Endless Light, and it is presented by the Shaker Square Collaborative at 13116 Shaker Square.
trains: Shaker Square is a stop on RTA's Blue and Green Line rapid trains, which is the easiest way to ride a train to the Festival of Lights, according to RTA. Farther away, the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs a holiday North Pole Adventure on vintage trains through Cuyahoga Valley National Park between Independence and Akron, and the Lorain and West Virginia Railway runs Santa Trains with short coach and caboose rides in Wellington, according to Rally Takes the Train's Cleveland guide. Book early, since holiday trains fill up.

faq: How does Shaker Heights celebrate Christmas?
The Shaker Square Collaborative holds a free Festival of Lights honoring Christmas, Hanukkah and Kwanzaa, and City Ballet of Cleveland holds a Sugarplum Fairy Tea each fall.
When is the Festival of Lights at Shaker Square?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 9 am to 7 pm.
Is the Festival of Lights free?
Yes, the city calendar calls it a day of free activities.
Can I take a train to Shaker Square?
RTA's Blue and Green Line rapid trains stop at Shaker Square, according to RTA.
